title: Different conditions leave room for mutuality
meaning: Changes to shared action are guided by a wish to combine different needs and emotionally expressed through living mutual involvement.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through changing shared actions as circumstances turn. Temperance in energy motivates you to find a combination of different needs, allowing them to influence a common decision. The Lovers in emotions bring a feeling of living mutuality: there is pleasure in experiencing the other person’s own response beside you. A workable option may therefore matter for its convenience and for the opportunity to remain interested in each other despite different habits.

For example, a new job means you can no longer listen to long programmes at the same time in the evening. You change the shared ritual: sometimes choosing a short episode, sometimes discussing what you heard separately. One person values a substantial conversation, while the other needs a free evening. **We participate differently, but our interest in each other remains alive.** Closeness develops through mutual attention, rather than through a requirement that every action happen at the same hour.

A difficulty appears if combining needs becomes a calculation intended to guarantee closeness. Each person formally has a place, but their actual interest may have changed. Any emotional difference then seems to violate a correctly established balance. Temperance as motivation cannot ensure automatic mutuality. The Lovers in emotions do not require identical pleasure in every shared activity or in every practical form you choose for it.
